faq.title: Questions importers ask before they start

items.q: How do we start working together?
items.a: Email your requirements to the export team at business@azafco.com.eg, or use the prepared message on this page. For fast deals, message our management directly on WhatsApp. We then review supply with you and confirm the commercial terms in writing.
Prices are confirmed per order. They depend on the species, weight grade, quantity, packing and delivery terms. We do not publish price lists.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: It depends on the species and the order terms. Send your expected quantity and we confirm what is possible for your order.

items.q: Which sizes and weight grades can you supply?
items.a: Weight grades depend on the species and current supply. Tell us the grade you need and we confirm what we can meet.
The 12 species on our site are our main, most-requested species; we supply other species on request.
Whole and fresh chilled, packed on ice in insulated EPS boxes. Other packing or your own specification is reviewed for each product.

items.q: Can you pack under our label?
items.a: This is reviewed for each product and requirement. Add your label requirements to the notes of your request.
We hold ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certificates. The export documents for each shipment are agreed for your destination.
Chilled, in our own refrigerated trucks from the plant, then by air or road freight depending on the destination. We do not publish fixed transit times; they are confirmed for each shipment.

items.q: Which markets do you ship to?
items.a: We ship to 7+ markets, including the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Lebanon, Qatar, Iraq and Syria. Europe, Russia and the USA are in our plan. If your country is not listed, contact the export team.

items.q: Do you take recurring supply programmes?
items.a: Yes. Our packing capacity is up to 2,500 t/month, and recurring supply is planned against it and your needs. Tell us the frequency you expect.

items.q: How do we know a message is really from AZAFCO International?
items.a: Our official channels are the export team email business@azafco.com.eg and the management WhatsApp +20 100 773 6419. Order terms are confirmed in writing for each order. If a message about your order comes from any other address or number, check it with us on these channels before you act on it.
